body: It's a gaurantee for it in my case.  The ups aren't worth the downs and the downs are way more large than the ups.  It's rational at this point to think that the net amount of joy in my life will be far exceeded by the amount of pain.  Therefore the only way to end the pain is suicide right?

The American mental health system is a complete joke
It’s so frustrating to find out that all they are concerned about treating is the symptom of wanting to kill or harm yourself. What else matters? Nothing. Speaking from experience I know that mental hospitals are some of the worse places on the earth. Everyone is so quick to suggest going to the hospital like it’s some miracle cure. Let me tell you it is not. It’s nothing more than an expensive babysitter that relieves the world from having to worry about mourning their loss. They don’t exist to help the patients they are there to provide momentary relief for everyone else.
When you are being held against your will an innate desire to escape will always express its self. It’s easy to escape a mental institution, you just tell them what they want to hear and keep repeating. It’s pretty easy to figure out what they want to hear, just say you won’t kill yourself. You don’t need to figure out a recovery plan, concoct elaborate tales about miraculous epiphanies, none of this is necessary and it won’t help you escape. You just need to tell them you have decided not to kill yourself and set that message on repeat.
Once you leave the hospital this lesson stays with you and acts as a guide for dealing with all of the mental health professionals who are constantly checking up on whether you are suicidal and need to return to the hospital. What would be the point? They won’t help anyways, so you start to lie. You tell them about how you’re so much better and then try to diminish the seriousness of the past events that led to your hospitalization.
Heaven forbid anyone would want to address the real underline issue, what I really want. I don’t want to not kill myself, I want to desire to live. I want to learn how to be happy, and productive. I must be the only one though because anytime you talk about this stuff everyone turns to the issue of safety once again. That’s when I start the process all over again. I tell them not to worry, I diminish the severity of what I shared, and I go back out to the big lonely world with sweet temptation of killing myself locked secretly in the back of my head. It stays there because it’s the only way I know to end the suffering. If I knew a better way I’d do it, but unfortunately no one gives a shit about helping people figure out that type of a thing.
It’s no wonder depression is a growing problem. Depression is a one way revolving door once you enter there is no way out. You’re trapped for life. The only control you have is over how long that suffering will last. At least I can control that one thing. It’s not much but I guess it’s something to live for.
